description: Heart-rate time series — resting HR and time in each HR zone. Give a single date + period, OR a date + endDate range. Fitbit REST: GET /1/user/-/activities/heart/date/{date}/{period|endDate}.json.

endDate.description: Range end date, yyyy-MM-dd or 'today' — if given, `period` is ignored.

period.description: Period ending at `date` — used only when `endDate` is omitted (default '1d').

name: fitbit_heart_rate
title: Heart rate
